faqs.title: Tumble Training Facility FAQs | Just Tumble CT | North Haven & Shelton CT
lines: Got a question? We’re here to help.
Regular class hours North Haven Location

Hours for private lessons and gym rentals vary by instructor and availability. For private lessons you can either go to our private lesson tab or contact us directly. for rental spaces please contact us directly.
*Hair pulled up securely, no hard hair accessories such as head bands and hair clips.
* Grippy socks or clean cheer shoes - no bare feet 🦶or street shoes 👟
*Bring a water bottle labeled with name.
Can I stay to watch my child?
Yes, you are welcome to stay and watch but once your student is comfortable attending, you are welcome to leave. Please make sure all of your contact information is up to date in your account.
How long do I have to commit to classes for?

Our classes are rolling, meaning they run all year. When a student ages out or levels up, our staff will suggest new classes to move up to. You may cancel at any time with 30 days notice to the first of the month. If your schedule changes, we can help you find a new class.
Is there a sibling discount or a multi class discount?
We offer a 20% sibling discount or 20% multi class discount off the additional classes. There are no discounts on the yearly registration fee.
At Just Tumble we do not have teams to join but we do support numerous youth, High School and College chear teams with lessons.
We also help out with group private classes for Dance Schools.
How long has Just Tumble been in business?
Just Tumble was born in 2012 in Shelton, CT. A second amazing location opened in North Haven on January 1, 2024.
Can I get a full refund?

Just Tumble does not currently offer full refunds. If your child is unable to attend a scheduled class, we are happy to provide make-up class options based on availability. In the event of an injury, we offer the option to pause your child’s membership until they are medically cleared to return with documentation from a licensed physician. For additional information or assistance please contact us directly.

about-us.title: Tumble Training Facility | Just Tumble CT | North Haven & Shelton, CT
lines: Just Tumble didn’t start in a building.
It started on football fields, with a small group of passionate coaches and one simple belief: when athletes learn how to move their bodies
, they can achieve far more than they ever thought possible.

Founded by Jason, Just Tumble grew out of years of hands-on experience teaching athletes how to understand their bodies—not just perform skills. From those early days teaching tumbling outdoors, the program steadily evolved into something bigger. Today, Just Tumble is a multi-facility company with over 45 dedicated employees, welcoming athletes from across New England who seek high-quality instruction from coaches who truly care.
What truly sets us apart isn’t just where we’ve been—it’s
why we do what we do

Our motto, “Skills and Smiles for Every Child,” isn’t just a phrase on the wall. It’s the standard we coach by every single day. Our team of talented, experienced, and passionate professionals brings expertise not only in tumbling, but in encouragement, confidence-building, and creating an environment where athletes feel safe, supported, and excited to learn.

Over the years, our students have included recreational athletes, high school competitors, All-Star National Champions, gymnasts, dancers, divers, football and basketball players (including an NFL prospect), TV and movie personalities, and even snowboarders. Yet the most important students to us are the ones who walk through our doors ready to learn, ready to have fun, and ready to just tumble.
At Just Tumble, we are united by one clear goal: to help every student grow—regardless of age, background, or athletic path. We achieve this by focusing on what matters most:
One of the best coach-to-student ratios possible
Clear expectations for progression, accountability, and safety

When athletes leave our gym, they leave with more than new skills. They leave with confidence, pride, and a smile—because at Just Tumble, Skills and Smiles for Every Child is not just our motto, it’s our promise.
We’re excited to help your child or athlete grow in skill, confidence, and joy.
Contact us today to discuss your goals and discover how Just Tumble can help make them a reality.

"Our mission is to provide each student with a safe and fun environment to improve upon not only their skills, but their SELF CONFIDENCE, STRENGTH, PROBLEM SOLVING SKILLS and most importantly PROPER TECHNIQUE"
"We believe in every student’s unique goals, and individual progression. It is important to us that all our students feel supported and encouraged, and these principles guide everything we do."

gymnastics.title: Tumbling Classes | Just Tumble CT | North Haven & Shelton, CT
lines: At Just Tumble we’re all about offering awesome tumbling classes for kids of all ages and skill levels! Whether your child is brand new to tumbling or already working on advanced skills, we’ve got them covered. Our certified coaches keep things fun, safe, and super encouraging—helping kids build not just skills, but confidence too. From beginners to experienced tumblers, everyone gets the attention they need to grow and shine.
Beginner Classes 7 and under (45 min class)

Beginner tumbling is the perfect way to get your athlete started! In this class, they’ll learn the basics of body control, strength, and flexibility while working on beginner tumbling skills like rolls, handstands, cartwheels, and more. We also mix in fun drills using tumbl traks and other training tools to help build confidence and coordination. Classes are 45minutes long and meet once a week—but if your child wants more time to tumble, they’re welcome to sign up for multiple classes!
Beginner Classes 7 and up (1 hour class)

These classes concentrate on the fundamentals of tumbling such as rolls, cartwheels, and  handstands, round offs and backbends. Our fun lesson plans prioritize safety, building strength, balance, and coordination. We tailor our approach to meet each student's unique
skill set and abilities, making adjustments as needed and pushing students to the best of their abilities.
These classes are specifically designed for our older students who are on the newer side of tumbling! In these classes we focus on the core fundamentals of tumbling.

Students will follow fun, structured lesson plans that prioritize safety while also building strength, balance, and coordination. Our teachers will tailor instructions to each individual child’s unique abilities making sure to help every athlete achieve their goals!

Our Intermediate Tumbling class is a great next step for athletes who’ve got the basics down and are ready to level up! In this class, we focus on building strength, control, and technique while learning skills like round-offs, back walkovers, and more advanced progressions. We also use tumbl traks and other fun equipment to boost power and confidence. Classes are 1 hour long, once a week—but if your tumbler can’t get enough, they’re welcome to join multiple classes!

Our Mixed Level Tumbling classes are for a mixture of different level athletes who have a solid foundation in basic skills such as forward rolls, cartwheels, and handstands, and are ready to advance to more challenging techniques. This class emphasizes the continued development of strength, body control, and proper technique while introducing skills like round-offs, back handsprings, and advanced progressions. We incorporate the use of tumbl traks and other specialized equipment to support skill development and build athlete confidence. Each class is 1 hour and 15 minutes in duration and held once per week. Athletes are welcome to enroll in multiple sessions to further enhance their training.

Advanced Tumbling is where things really get exciting! This class is perfect for athletes who have strong fundamentals and are ready to tackle skills like multiple back handsprings, tucks, aerials, and more. We focus on refining technique, building power, and pushing each tumbler to reach their full potential—safely and confidently. Classes run for 1 hour and 15minutes once a week, and if your athlete wants even more time to train, they can absolutely sign up for extra sessions!

Elite Tumbling is where your athlete can truly level up! This class is designed for experienced tumblers who are ready to push their limits with high-level skills like multiple tumbling passes, layouts, twisting, and advanced combos. We focus on perfecting technique, boosting power, and helping each athlete perform at their absolute best. Classes are 1 hour and 15 minutes long, once a week.

Private lessons are a great place for your athlete to continue to elevate their tumbling skills with one-on-one instruction. Private lessons provide athletes with individualized coaching focused on their specific skill goals. Each lesson is tailored to the athlete’s needs and utilizes a variety of equipment available in the gym along with personally being spotted and guided by our trained staff. Lessons can be booked in single session or multiple session based on availability. Please read the cancellation and rescheduling policy for private lessons.

The Company follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services' analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users' movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.

Like any other website, The Company uses "cookies". These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users' experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors' browser type and/or other basic public shared information.
Privacy Policies (If Third Party Ads Are Present)
You may consult this list to find the Privacy Policy for each of the advertising partners of The Company (if applicable).

Third-party ad servers or ad networks uses technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on The Company, which are sent directly to users' browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit.
Note that The Company has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.

The Company's Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.

You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers' respective websites.
Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.

The Company does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

This Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in The Company. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website.
By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its Terms and Conditions.

lines: Summer Camps run Mondays through Fridays every summer.
12:15 pm - 3:15 pm Specialty camps for ages 5 - 18
HAVE A BLAST AT SUMMER CAMP
Summer camp runs Monday-Friday. Campers must be ages 6+ to attend 9am-4:30pm camps. Campers ages 3-5 are invited to join from 9am-12:30pm.
Each week will focus on a different camp theme (check them out below!). Camp will consist of gymnastics classes, theme-related crafts, summertime games, a show-and-tell performance, and more!
